name: Borealopelta
sum: Borealopelta is a large Early Cretaceous nodosaurid from Alberta, known from a spectacularly preserved armoured body with skin and stomach contents.
wsnote: Estimates given in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: The 'Suncor nodosaur', a nearly complete front half with armour in life positions — Clearwater Formation, Millennium Mine, Alberta.
material: One specimen, found in 2011 at an oil sands mine.
exceptional: Armour in life positions with keratin sheaths, overlying skin and stomach contents.
biology: Straight tail without club and a pair of long shoulder spines; a flexible keratin layer up to 16 cm covered its bony armour.
author: Brown et al. 2017
